tie_break: exact score ties: tree before forest, then shallower depth, larger leaf, unweighted before balanced
preprocessing: none: validated integer features, no missing values; no scaling needed for trees
rationale: Depth/leaf pairs span a strongly regularized tree, moderate flexibility and a deeper low-bias candidate. Same budget for both families; weighting probes minority-label tradeoffs. Fixed 200-tree forests and two workers limit compute. No expansion after evaluation.
